source: De Dion-Bouton single at the front, 270-273 cc, 1.75 hp; three speeds plus reverse with direct-drive third ('prise directe'); cardan shaft, rear axle and differential; one pedal for brake and declutch (Renault Histoire; Wikipedia). Governed speed, gearbox ratios, the 5.8 bevel final drive (direct third gives about 32 km/h, Wikipedia's top speed) and the rear-drum brake location and capacity are assumptions. Reverse gear is not simulated.
